svg.text: N12 · Inverting amplifier
Feedback sets the gain
Post-16 · ages 16–19
The input signal reaches the inverting input through a resistor. A feedback
resistor returns part of the output to the same node.
Your investigation
Predict the signed gain from the resistor ratio. Check amplitude, inversion
and output clipping.
This activity
Change feedback ratio, compare signed gain and inspect clipping with an
adequately realistic model.
Getting started
Open the Simulation tab and press Run. Select a source or component to
see its values. Read the labelled signals, then change one quantity at a
time. Equal net labels identify connected points.
Explain:
Use an equation, a truth table or a state sequence to justify your
prediction. Include units and discuss the model assumptions.
The model predicts electrical behaviour; it does not replace real practical
measurements.
